intent: Bring python_pkg/wsg_grabber/review.py under the 250-line file cap by extracting its two independent concerns -- state-to-text rendering and undo -- into sibling modules, keeping every public name reachable at review.* for ui.py and the tests.
scope: Non-goal: no behaviour change, no test changes, no change to the ReviewCommand contract with ui.py
changes: Moved the pure presentation functions -- emptiness, status_line, filename_line, title_line, render -- plus the _BYTES_PER_MIB constant into _render.py.
Moved the undo group -- can_undo, on_undo, forget_last -- into _undo.py.
review.py re-exports all eight through __all__; both new modules import SessionState under TYPE_CHECKING only, so there is no runtime circular import.
Inlined the single-caller passthrough helper _worker_message (it only returned event.message) and dropped the now-unused WorkerFailed import.
render() now spells the undo predicate as `state.undoable > 0` rather than calling review.can_undo, which is the identical expression and avoids a runtime import cycle between _render and _undo.
review.py 330 -> 196 lines; _render.py 107; _undo.py 74. All three under the cap.

verification.command: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -c "from python_pkg.wsg_grabber import review; [getattr(review, n) for n in review.__all__]"
verification.evidence: Printed 'all 15 names resolve'. Every name in __all__ is a live attribute on review, so callers using the old review.<name> path are unaffected by the move.

All hooks pass with no output after filtering Passed/Skipped: ruff, ruff format, mypy, pylint, bandit, and 'pytest with coverage enforcement' (which runs the full wsg_grabber suite at the 100% branch-coverage gate). No suppression was added.

risks: _render and _undo both type-reference SessionState from review, which imports them back; this is only safe because those references sit under TYPE_CHECKING. Adding a runtime import of review to either module would create a cycle.
Inlining _worker_message removes a named seam; it was a pure one-line passthrough with a single caller and zero test references, so the behaviour is identical.
rollback: git revert the commit; review.py returns to its 330-line form and _render.py / _undo.py are deleted.
After rollback, run python3 -m pytest python_pkg/wsg_grabber/tests/ -q to confirm the suite still passes.
